title: Chapter 101 — AI Operations for the Trade Desk
intro: The specialist's machine — daily rhythm, account workflows, BD engine.

sections.title: The Trade Specialist's AI Stack
sections.content:
Trade specialists can use AI for: daily account check-ins, quote generation, outreach sequences, project tracking, lead-time monitoring, and account review preparation.

A structured AI workflow for the trade desk turns a one-person operation into something that feels like a full department. The AI handles the administration. The specialist handles the relationships.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating trade AI usage, ask:

Is the trade specialist using AI for daily workflow — or doing everything manually?
Is AI freeing up time for relationship building — or creating more screen time?
Are trade operations becoming more efficient with AI — or staying the same?
